title: Prosper
tagline: Enabling Faster & Rewarding open source Development on GitHub
description:
Open source projects like Typescript, Tensorflow, React-Native, Dall-E & many more have hundreds of pull requests starving to get a comment from the project maintainers & get merged into the main code base. 

Starvation of pull requests has lead to 
1) Delayed Software Delivery
2) The developer may get frustrated & loose motivation to contribute to the project
3) Bussiness discontinuity due to P0 bugs.

how_its_made:
1) It was a challenge to integrate setting notification of Push protocol with a subscription and unsunscription model. 

2) Chainlink CCIP was not compatible with scroll due to which we could not implement it and we hope that the Chainlink - Scroll Bridges are deployed soon.

3) Integration of Smart Contract with the Fronted was challenging because we faced many issues.
